standard_prerequisites.name: Dual axioms
standard_prerequisites.statement: The dual axioms T_Diamond (p implies Diamond p), B_Diamond (Diamond Box p implies p), 4_Diamond (Diamond Diamond p implies Diamond p) and 5_Diamond (Diamond Box p implies Box p) are available in the systems containing their box counterparts, and D is its own dual.
standard_prerequisites.use: Several derivations take an instance of a dual axiom or rewrite a Box/Diamond form through one (the source marks these as 'with ... for p').

standard_prerequisites.name: The RK rule and propositional closure
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every normal modal logic is closed under RK and under propositional reasoning (PL), and contains its defining axiom instances.
standard_prerequisites.use: Lines marked RK apply the rule to a previously derived implication; final lines combine derived implications by PL.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1276-1289): six provability facts - KT5 proves B; KT5 proves 4; KDB4 proves T; KB4 proves 5; KB5 proves 4; KT proves D.

Items (1)-(2) (proof lines 1293-1311): KT5 proves B by combining the 5 instance Diamond A implies Box Diamond A with the dual-T instance A implies Diamond A; KT5 proves 4 by the same pair instantiated at Box A, one 5_Diamond step, an RK application and a PL combination.

Items (3)-(4) (proof lines 1312-1328): KDB4 proves T by chaining B_Diamond with the D instance at Box A, then the 4 axiom and a PL combination; KB4 proves 5 by the B instance at Diamond A, the 4_Diamond instance, an RK application and a PL combination.

Items (5)-(6) (proof lines 1329-1351): KB5 proves 4 by the B instance at Box A, the 5_Diamond instance, an RK application and a PL combination; KT proves D by combining the T instance with the dual-T instance.
proof_roadmap: For each claim, fix the containing system and list its defining axioms.
Derive the needed intermediate implication from a defining or dual axiom instance.
Apply RK where a boxed implication is needed and close each derivation by PL.
difficulty_reason: System provability facts (statement 1276-1289, proof 1291-1351): all six derivations carried in full in span, each a complete axiom-chain argument. H2.
